title: fix(components): action:menu and action:group take the host's disabled by name (objectui#11182)
body:
Fixes #11182

Clause-②: no

Implemented by `os-dev` in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`, dispatched under claim comment 5912386098 (`domain:ui#1`).

## What changed

`action:menu` and `action:group` now take the host's forwarded `disabled` by name. This is the objectui#9131 rule `action:button` and `action:icon` already follow. There is one convention and no new helper.

- **`action:menu`** destructures `disabled: hostDisabled` off the props, so `...rest` no longer carries a `disabled` key. The trigger is `disabled={hostDisabled || loading}`. The menu declares no enablement gate of its own: the renderer reads none, the registry `inputs` publish none, and `ActionMenuPropsSchema` in `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 declares no `disabled` or `enabled`. So none was invented.
- **`action:group`** destructures `disabled: hostDisabled` the same way. Inline mode hands it to every `InlineActionButton`, where it leads the OR: `hostDisabled || (declared gate) || loading`. Dropdown mode puts it on the trigger: `hostDisabled || dropdownLoading`. The wrapping div no longer receives it.
- Both parameter annotations declare `disabled?: boolean`, as `ActionButtonRendererProps` does. The annotation is inline and not exported, so no public type changes.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/components` patch.

## The defect, measured red before any source edit

`SchemaRenderer` forwards `disabled: __disabled || undefined`. The key is always present and only the value is conditional. `action:menu` wrote `disabled={loading}` and then spread `{...rest}`, so the forwarded `undefined` overwrote the in-flight verdict.

The new pin was run on the untouched tree first. Its in-flight row read:

```
direct: { spinning: true, disabled: true }
node:   { spinning: true, disabled: false }
```

That is the card's probe reading exactly. A menu rendered through `SchemaRenderer` showed its spinner while its trigger stayed pressable.

## action:group, measured in the same pass

A scratch probe used the real `SchemaRenderer` and an inline group with `disabled: true` on the node. It was deleted after the run. Its reading on the untouched tree:

```
hostDisabled true -> wrapper DIV, disabled attribute "", member button disabled false
hostDisabled none -> wrapper DIV, no disabled attribute, member button disabled false
```

So the forwarded `disabled` did reach the wrapper, where it disables nothing. In dropdown mode the host verdict was dropped, and the trigger stayed pressable. Both modes reproduced red in the new pin before the fix.

The in-flight half does not reproduce on the group. The dropdown trigger never spread `rest`, and inline members keep their own loading state. So only the host-disabled half was changed.

## Tests

New `packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-menu-host-disabled-11182.test.tsx`. It uses the real `SchemaRenderer`, the real registry, and an `api` handler held in flight until the test settles it:

- In-flight member: the trigger is disabled on both channels (direct registry mount and `SchemaRenderer`), read as one object, and it re-enables on both when the action settles.
- A host-disabled menu stays disabled. This covers a node `disabled: true`, a node predicate, and `properties.disabled`.
- A menu the host disables while its action runs stays disabled after the action settles.
- An idle menu with no gate, or with a false predicate, is pressable on both channels.
- Group, inline: every member is disabled, and the wrapper carries no `disabled` attribute. Group, dropdown: the trigger is disabled. With no gate or a false gate, both modes are pressable.

**Red before the fix** (commit `cfc9b6db98`, test staged, no source edit): 3 failed, 4 passed (7). The failures were the in-flight row and the two host-disabled group rows.

**Ablation** was run from the committed fix on `06e5657081`. Each leg overwrote the file, printed anchor counts, ran the file, then restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Each restore was proven by blob hashes equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| Leg | Anchor counts after the edit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `action-menu.tsx` at base | `hostDisabled` 0, `disabled={loading}` 1 | 1 failed: the in-flight row |
| `action-group.tsx` at base | `hostDisabled` 0, `disabled={dropdownLoading}` 1 | 2 failed: the inline and dropdown rows |
| menu keeps the destructure, drops `hostDisabled` from the OR | OR 0, `disabled={loading}` 1 | 2 failed: the two host-disabled menu rows |

## Local gates

Commands and results:

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build` exited 0 (7 packages).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` exited 0 on `06e5657081`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test file.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/` plus the two `packages/react` pins (`SchemaRenderer.disabledDeclaredGate.test.tsx`, `SchemaRenderer.enablementEnvelopeConfigBag.test.tsx`) on `06e5657081`: Test Files 32 passed (32), Tests 530 passed (530).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/ --maxWorkers=2` on `b9967bba99`: Test Files 342 passed, 1 skipped (343). The later commits change only the new test file and the changeset, and the action-directory run above covers that test file.
- On `809de9ca8e` (HEAD), all exited 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- On `06e5657081`, both exited 0: `pnpm check:action-forward-parity`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`.
- ESLint on the three touched sources: 0 errors. The warning counts equal the base versions (menu 11, group 15, all pre-existing `no-explicit-any`), and the new test has 0. The root config uses `tseslint.configs.recommended` with no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem, so this diff cannot move the verdict of an untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` run is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

These were read from source and not measured. They were not filed:

- `action:menu` still spreads the raw `rest` onto the trigger, where `action:button` and `action:icon` pass it through `toFormControlDomProps`. The node's other keys therefore reach the trigger's props. The inline `action:group` wrapper receives its other keys the same way. Carrier: none.
- `autoTrigger` members of a menu that is disabled from mount still run. `useAutoTriggerOnce` consults the action's `visible`, not the enablement verdict, which is the same as on `action:button`. This was seen once, on the menu only, by the first draft of the settle row. The row was then rewritten so it no longer depends on that behaviour. Carrier: none.

objectui#11212 (the permission-predicate fault policy on `action:group` / `action:icon`) is serial behind this PR on `action-group.tsx`. No `visible` or `disabled` predicate fault policy was changed here.
